knowledge_gaps: The method is not reproducible yet: tau, the alpha grid, residual scaling, empty-history handling, and global versus category-specific weight selection are unspecified.
For an unobserved transition from an observed source, the residual equals -n_i*p(j)/(n_i+tau). This introduces a source-frequency-dependent popularity penalty that needs a separate control.

The diagnostic scoring contract lacks sequence context for the transition branch. Unless adapted, predict_score(features, items) may diagnose SASRec alone while the deployed predictor uses combined scores.
The potential score of 8 lacks experimental support. Sparse transition coverage, validation-search overfitting, and the contribution beyond popularity correction remain unmeasured.

follow_up_queries.reason: Determine whether improvements would reflect useful transition information or primarily a popularity penalty, and identify appropriate alternative baselines.
follow_up_queries.query: In sequential recommendation, how do additive transition models using r(i,j)=(C[i,j]+tau*p(j))/(n_i+tau)-p(j) compare with popularity-only score correction, conditional log-lift, and history-aware item-item models? Examine sparse-transition coverage, source-frequency effects, and ablations that isolate transition information from popularity debiasing.

follow_up_queries.reason: Resolve implementation details needed for reproducible scoring and architecture-aware diagnostics.
follow_up_queries.query: How should a SASRec plus sparse last-item transition ensemble implement training-only score normalization, smoothing strength, empty-history fallbacks, and efficient candidate/full-catalog scoring? Describe how per-position diagnostic scoring can receive the corresponding source item so diagnostic and deployed ensemble scores agree.

follow_up_queries.reason: Specify a small, defensible validation search and distinguish exploratory gains from selection noise.
follow_up_queries.query: For recommender ensemble tuning with four equally weighted datasets, 200 fixed validation users per dataset, and 99 fixed negative candidates per user, what limited hyperparameter-search and paired uncertainty protocol is appropriate? Compare shared versus per-dataset ensemble weights and explain why a paired bootstrap after selecting the best configuration does not correct validation-selection optimism.
